mechanism_relevant_findings: The high conductivity contribution from structural diffusion in neat phosphoric acid (H3PO4) passes through a maximum at higher water contents.
Structural diffusion virtually disappears in H3PO4·2H2O but overall conductivity increases with more water due to enhanced vehicle transport.
Hydrogen bond network frustration is closely related to the appearance of structural diffusion and decreases with changes in water content.

relevance_judgement.reason: The findings provide significant insights into the proton transport mechanisms and their dependency on water content.
